diagrams.title: Improve one crop bed
diagrams.question: Does this upgrade make every crop faster or unlock a new crop
diagrams.summary: The same bed gains speed. Crop species and crop-level requirements stay separate.
caveats: No minimum explorer level is checked by upgradeBed.
Prices are per bed and per next level, not a fee for all nine beds.
Normal and Hard multiply bed-upgrade prices by 1.5.
Existing growing crops retain their completion fraction while their duration is halved; an upgrade does not remove growth already earned.
Ordinary duration calculations round to milliseconds and have a one-millisecond minimum. First-run tutorial timing is a separate modifier.
This is not a path from carrot to radish or a crop unlock tree.

diagrams.title: Choose a permanent stat wish
diagrams.question: Which improvement changes the explorer rather than one owned item
diagrams.summary: Four independent energy-only counters. Each repeats its own next-rank price curve.
caveats: Each stat uses its own current rank; buying Health does not raise the Attack price.
Health also heals 25 current HP, capped by the new maximum; it is not a full heal.
Critical wishes stop at rank28. Other wish counters have no explicit finite rank cap in upgrade().
A +3 Attack wish changes base attack; final attack also depends on level, equipped items, forging and buffs.
These wishes do not replace the deterministic gear bench or weapon forge.
No player-level gate or material cost is checked in the shared upgrade rule.

caveats: All three rods currently have gearLevel gate0. This is a rule fact, not a promise that advanced materials are available in the opening.
Golden needs bone3 and sap2; Steady needs coral4 and pearl2. Material acquisition and player knowledge can delay them.
There are no rod-to-rod upgrade edges, no mandatory prior rod, and no wooden-rod ingredient.
Rods cannot be forged and do not receive +10 gear-bench levels.
A rod is automatically held near suitable water when calm; quality influences catch handling, not combat attack.
Strain snap chance is per tension strain, not the overall chance of losing a cast. Steady adds a 0.4s bite window and reduces tension/heaviness.
Shop recipes are purchases with resource costs, not a required workbench or Ancient furnace crafting route.

formulas.forgeMaterials: bone=leather=4+2n; starshard=1+floor(n/3); moonstone=1+floor((n-5)/4) when n>=5; firecore=n-8 when n>=10
formulas.forgeAttack: Final attack includes multiplier 1 + heldWeaponForgeLevel/100; do not present it as only the Wood sword item +6 changing.
formulas.benchMaterials: leather=2+n; bone=1+floor(n/2); starshard=n-4 when n>=5; moonstone=1 when n>=8

caveats: There is no Wood sword to Stone sword to Metal sword evolution recipe. Do not connect separate weapon catalog entries with upgrade arrows.
Forge failure spends the full attempt price/materials, leaves the same level, consumes no sword and never downgrades.
The shown compressed arrows cover several successful levels; each attempt has its own cost. Expand the full cost table on demand.
Weapon forging is offered from Strengthen weapons and the Upgrade bench. It is distinct from Ancient furnace recipes and does not require furnaceReady().
Bench gear levelling applies to non-keepsake hats, outfits, boots and pets, up to+10. Weapons use forging; disguises and rods are not this lane.

The Straw hat is only an example. Every hat converges to the same six-stat ceiling, but other slot ceilings and item-dependent energy costs differ. Pet attack abilities retain their own identity and +4% per bench level.
At home loose bag materials are spent first, then chest materials. The owned item must be in the bag record, including an equipped copy.
Online bench gear upgrades also require an active accepted indoor pose near the bench. Shared offline rules alone do not encode that server proximity condition.
These diagrams explain available systems, not mandatory chapter-one spending or a claim that all materials are naturally available then.

staticValidationPlan.check: Parse HTML and embedded data locally; every tab target, chapter anchor, asset ID and graph edge endpoint resolves exactly once; all relative resource paths exist.
At most12nodes each; unique IDs; no self/dangling edges; edge labels include prices/probability as applicable; exact step tables match imported pure rules.

Bed0..5 cap and1/2/4/8/16/32speed; cost sum3720Easy/5580NormalHard. Rodrecipes20empty,150bone3sap2,900coral4pearl2. Forge15levels,50%first5and30%later; all failures spend cost with no downgrade. Hatbench10levels and imported per-step costs/stat ceilings.

Inspect pure filtering logic using inert example data in plain Node: case-insensitive expected matches, empty query restores all, zero results branch and combined filters. Do not execute a browser client through Node.

Static parser verifies buttons for actions, associated labels, valid aria-controls, alt text, dialog close control, Escape/focus-handling code and no duplicate IDs. This cannot establish actual focus behavior.
Read image metadata and CSS: valid dimensions, aspect-preserving object-fit, defined max-width, responsive columns/overflow treatment. This is not visual acceptance.

Search final HTML/CSS/JS for unexpected HTTP(S), protocol-relative URLs, remoteimports, fetch/XHR/WebSocket/EventSource and external fonts/scripts. Source links may be deliberate, but opening the book must not require them.

Ensure all contentdata is inline or statically embedded and resources are relative; no file-fetch/module-origin dependency for file-open. Root performs actual file-open behavior in permitted CUA if available.
Inspect @media print rules for navigation hiding, restored filtered content, sensible page breaks and nonclipped diagrams/tables. Actual print layout remains CUA or renderer verification.
